svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Component · Metadata scope · project · narrow
svg.desc: Mirrors MetadataScopeControl in App/MetadataPanelSections.swift — the Whole project / This frame switch an interval project shows above the Info and Metadata groups (a Photo or video project is one asset and draws nothing here). This frame adds the frame stepper: ‹ · the frame's file name over 'n of N' · ›, the back chevron dimmed on the first frame. Frame scope reads and writes that frame's own line in assets.ndjson; Whole project the project record. Width is the macOS Gallery preview panel's 272pt column.
